accepted_false_invalid.rationale: The 48-frame synchronization region cannot satisfy the selected 64-frame minimum overlap; preserving invalid is safer than accepting a spurious lag.

rationale: OP-A-permissive is rejected because holdout accepted lag 8 when the oracle was 41, violating the zero-false-valid criterion.
OP-B-intermediate and OP-C-conservative both produced zero false-valid, zero wrong-lag valid, and zero false-ambiguous on holdout.
OP-B-intermediate produced one false-invalid while OP-C-conservative produced two, so OP-B preserves the same observed safety with less unnecessary rejection.
The remaining OP-B false-invalid is the declared 48-frame synchronization-region limitation under minimum_overlap_frames=64.
OP-C-conservative additionally rejected a valid 0.0005 FS case because of its 0.001 FS RMS floor; that extra M1 cost is not accepted.
